sections.Interpretation: Haemoglobin, red cell count, haematocrit and red cell indices are within the adult female reference ranges, with normocytic, normochromic red cells and a normal red cell distribution width. The total white cell count and all five differential populations, including their absolute counts, are within reference limits. The platelet count and mean platelet volume are normal. These findings indicate a normal blood count, with no evidence of anaemia, infection, inflammation or thrombocytopenia. No further haematological action is required on the basis of this result.
